meta.title: Build on Frankencoin: contracts, API, indexer and MCP server
meta.description: Integrate ZCHF and FCS: verified contracts on eight chains, a public REST API, a self-hostable Ponder indexer, an MCP server and npm packages.

hero.title: A programmable|Swiss franc.
hero.subtitle: Open source and permissionless: verified contracts on eight chains, a public API with no key, and an indexer you can run yourself.

snippet.title: Live protocol figures
snippet.note: Returns ZCHF supply per chain, collateral and the equity reserve as JSON. No key, no wallet.

tools.title: Smart contracts
tools.description: Frankencoin, MintingHub, Savings, Equity (FPS) and FCS in Solidity. Audited and verified on every chain.

tools.title: REST API
tools.description: Positions, prices, challenges, savings and analytics as JSON, with Swagger docs.

tools.title: Indexer (Ponder)
tools.description: The event index behind the API and the app. Self-host it for your own queries.

tools.title: MCP server
tools.description: Gives an AI agent read access to protocol state and positions.
